entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
I need to start a return. Order number VF-129834.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order... okay, I see it. The VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered December 15th.
That's the one. Just send me the return label.
Of course. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or just a matter of preference?
It doesn't matter. I tried to do this over two weeks ago and your whole system was down. I got a website error and couldn't print the label. I even have a screenshot. So, are we doing this or not?
I apologize for that inconvenience. We did have a known issue around that time. Let me just confirm the policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've got it here. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. No problem at all.
90 days? Fine. Just email me the label.

Absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. You will receive an email with the prepaid shipping label within the next 5-10 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any shipping center.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
